purpose: Pitch-competition audit trail of human-led, GenAI-assisted PHVS research and valuation
coverage: Selected material exchanges recovered from visible conversation and repository artifacts; not an exhaustive transcript or exact tool chronology.

process.human_role: Defines investment questions, challenges assumptions, supplies licensed expert calls and sell-side reports, proposes hypotheses and comparative methods, selects scenarios.
process.ai_role: Retrieves and organizes evidence, checks definitions, translates hypotheses into explicit calculations, implements and tests models, records uncertainty and corrections.
constraints: Preserve both long and short arguments
process.validation_caveat: Source verification, independent arithmetic and sensitivity tests have occurred; systematic multi-prompt replication and independent external adoption validation have not been completed.

events.objective: Test whether RAPIDe-3 patient disposition undermines efficacy evidence.
events.user_contribution: Questioned 88 paired participants versus 134 randomized, attack frequency, study closure and prophylaxis use; requested granular evidence rather than accepting headline results.
events.prompt_excerpt: why there were only 88 of 134
events.ai_method_and_sources: Organized registry/CTIS participant-flow evidence and distinguished randomized people, treated people, paired people and treated attacks.
events.snapshot: 134 randomized;113 treated201 attacks;88 treated both attacks;25 treated one;21 treated none.35 sponsor-closure cases were part of46 incomplete participants.
events.thesis_effect: Weakened an initial missing-patient short argument; incomplete paired observation cannot automatically be called toxicity or efficacy withdrawal.
events.value_add: Made dispersed denominators and disposition categories comparable, turning suspicion into a testable reconciliation.
events.limitations_and_checks: Aggregate reconciliation does not establish absence of informative missingness or recover patient-level outcomes. Backfill is not a claim of a pre-registered audit.

events.objective: Assess comparative efficacy before translating headline differences into market share.

events.snapshot: FDA changed missing-assessment censoring for sebetralstat; placebo median became not estimable versus the published6.72 hours. CHAPTER-3 protocol specified overdispersion and supplementary negative-binomial analysis.
events.thesis_effect: Corrected earlier simplistic placebo-gap interpretation and weakened claims that variability was ignored; superiority and amendment impact remain unresolved.
events.value_add: Detected that superficially comparable headline statistics used different analysis rules and narrowed which concerns remained decision-relevant.
events.limitations_and_checks: No linked patient dataset or complete original/revised SAP comparison recovered. Mechanistic plausibility and cross-trial signals are not proof of superiority.
